context: Commons metadata precondition; may be wrapped by an image-import failure. Commons is the service name.

english: Commons metadata returned an ambiguous file
context: Metadata response matched zero OR multiple files; do not narrow this to multiple matches.
File missing, namespace absent, or response is not a file. Metadata-only credit and image insertion share this reason.

english: Commons attribution does not match the selected original file
context: The attribution metadata identifies a different original image. Keep attribution distinct from the edited drawing.
The provider supplied an invalid Commons file-description page URL.

english: Commons attribution field exceeds the text limit
context: Raw attribution field exceeds the text-length limit before HTML is decoded; not a response-byte or rendered-text limit.
Could not retain the provider metadata snapshot. This is not a drawing, edited-credit, or clipboard save failure.

english: The Commons download redirected to a different original file.
context: Image insertion only: an allowed download redirect identifies a different Commons original.

english: Could not encode blank map as PNG
context: Commons SVG image insertion only: PNG compression returned failure. PNG is a format identifier.
